source_judgments: R864 and R865 have optional double colons and mandatory nonempty lists. The independent complete grammar-head scan confirms explicit R1534/C1571 and R804/C810 respectively, not assumed R402 or selected-designator productions.

VALUE controls require actual data dummies, valid declarations, explicit interfaces and one attribute route. C867 and C839 retain separate assumed-size/coarray/PSC and assumed-rank exclusions. Ordinary non-BIND explicit-shape arrays are not universally excluded.
C868 applies to the dummy's own attributes, not every component. C869's OPTIONAL+VALUE prohibition depends on BIND. Present/absent and actual/effective-argument distinctions remain canonical.

The anonymous definable effective object and component values retain15.5.2.4/7.5.8 ownership. Pointer association is not deep-copy isolation of the pointed-at payload; aliases, defined states and live targets remain necessary.
TARGET+VALUE escaped pointers become undefined at procedure completion under15.5.2.5p12. No post-return ASSOCIATED inquiry, physical-copy, stack-address, allocator or callback oracle is introduced.
C870 excludes INTENT(IN) dummies, including pointer dummies. USE/HOST/BLOCK identity and C871/C872 are independent constraints; BLOCK USE construct identity does not waive C871.
Noncoarray association permission does not waive15.5.2.5p22 coarray-PSC actual/dummy matching. Actual coarrays and coarray pointer targets retain15.5.2.9/10.2.2.3p7.
Subobject propagation follows9.4.2p5: a sole rightmost pointer is a subobject in association-status contexts, not arbitrary dereferenced-target or earlier-pointer-hop contexts.

Both8.5.20p5 clauses and the adjacent pointer/EQUIVALENCE advice are should recommendations. P3's pointer shall depends on actual external target events, not a target keyword alone. No mandatory timing, atomicity, synchronization or load/store strategy is inferred.
VALUE in BLOCK is excluded by C1107; USE has no VALUE re-attribution exception. The host-associated VALUE lead remains a conditional identity/attribute source gate, not an invented blanket rule.
C_INT support is independently grounded in18.2.2p3, while all18.3.7 reference/interface/prototype/implementation conditions remain gated. No C text, ABI profile or companion execution was supplied.
Both p1 paragraphs are attribute-route definitions rather than new local S effects. All23 plans remain pending; no fixture, numbered-wrapper link or SourceUse instance is authored.
